verdict.reasons: The white-and-blue cylindrical carton roll is clearly the AFP drip-tape product. Branding and water-drop logo match the owner-approved captions, and typography follows the cylinder shape. The gauge with coiled thin tubing matches the requested pressure-testing context without using the packaging as plumbing hardware. No alternate hose products, people, or layout defects are present. Minor advisory: the fine-print spec panel is not legible at this scale.

focused_physical_review.reason: The white-and-blue AFP commercial package sits on the soil with a broad, uninterrupted visible soil gap around its complete footprint, including the side nearest the black irrigation loop. The black tubing loop and pressure gauge remain on the right and do not touch, emerge from, cross underneath, or reappear behind the package. No distinct additional loose uninstalled coil or roll is present; the black line is a continuous installed lateral connected to the gauge. The carton sides and base are smooth with no visible protruding white ribbon, strap, or tape tail.
